source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

intelligence.enrichment: A food item may show the presence of more than one nutrient; peanuts show the presence of both proteins and fats. multiple positive food-test results for one food item -> evidence that the item contains multiple nutrients The learner correctly applies this rule: A food item may show the presence of more than one nutrient; peanuts show the presence of both proteins and fats. Each food item belongs to exactly one nutrient group, so one positive test cancels the others.
